invariants.claim: Callbacks with an in-flight request, non-Drawing status, mismatched request ID, word count other than one, or timestamp at/after deadline emit the ignored event and perform no state writes.
Accepted callbacks select a one-based entry within the positive uint128 sold-entry interval and store entry, resolution timestamp and terminal status.
The result is NftWon iff totalEntries >= reserveEntries; later callbacks cannot overwrite it because only Drawing passes.
The only callee is callbackDeadline; result selection makes no external calls, loops or transfers and does not allocate payouts.

assumptions.claim: Incoming calls have authenticated wrapper origin before this internal handler executes.
totalEntries is positive and remains fixed while Drawing, supplying the modulo divisor precondition at Raffle.sol:L518.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.requestDraw rejects zero at L243 before setting Drawing at L252; Raffle.buyEntries requires Active at L215 and writes totalEntries at L230; _requireStatus enforces equality at L573-L575.

assumptions.claim: The callback deadline is request time plus two days only when stored drawRequestedAt is nonzero; otherwise the helper returns zero and no timestamp passes.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.callbackDeadline at L463-L465 and RaffleConstants.DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT at L35-L36; Raffle.fulfillRandomWords comparison at L512.

assumptions.claim: The canonical service supplies randomness with the intended unpredictability/distribution; the inspected origin gate and modulo calculation do not establish those properties (base L101-L107; Raffle.sol:L518).
The explicit uint64 timestamp conversions preserve the full request/resolution time only when block.timestamp fits uint64; there is no local bound check (Raffle.sol:L253, L520).

calls.propagates: Returns uint256(drawRequestedAt) + DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT when drawRequestedAt != 0, otherwise zero; caller depends on this for the exclusive callback deadline at L512. Constant is two days (RaffleConstants.sol:L35-L36). No nested calls or state writes.
